column4: 洞窟に落ちたエール、一人っきり
column5: El fell into the cave, all alone.

column4: 上に向かって声をかけるが返事がない
column5: He calls out upwards, but there is no reply.

column4: だいぶ深く落ちたのかもしれない
column5: He might have fallen quite deep.

column4: 動かずに救出を待つのが正しいとされるが
column5: It is said to be correct to stay still and wait for rescue,

column4: じっとしていてもだんだん不安になる
column5: but staying still only makes you increasingly anxious.
(In the atmosphere of a survival story)

column4: そうしているうちに、ぐらぐらと揺れ始め
column5: While doing so, the ground begins to shake unsteadily,

column4: 自分の居た場所が崩れ始める
column5: and the place where he stood begins to collapse.

column4: あわててそこを離れ移動する
column5: He hastily leaves and moves away.
